REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS
OPIOID SETTLEMENT TRUST FUND
The County of Blair is seeking proposals from private individuals, organizations, public or
governmental agencies, community-based organizations, nonprofits, tribes/tribal
organizations, schools and school districts that are interested in providing products and/or
services to the citizens of Blair County in accordance with the rules and regulations set
forth by the Opioid Settlement Trust Fund
.
Completed application packets, available at the link below, along with all required
documentation, should be returned to
BlairCountyOpioidSettlement@blaircountypa.gov
no later than
October 9, 2026.
The County of Blair reserves the right to award one or
more proposals, to reject any or all submissions or to waive any informalities in the
submission process.
To request a copy or to submit questions regarding this request, please contact: Tricia
Johnson, Department of Social Services, Blair County Courthouse, 423 Allegheny Street,
Suite 441B, Hollidaysburg, PA 16648, by calling (814) 693-3023 Extension #1480, or
email:
BlairCountyOpioidSettlement@blaircountypa.gov
